classification.difficultyReason: Construct two sectors from specified lengths and angles, halving the diameter in the second part.

content.prompt: Use your protractor and compasses to draw a sector with:

children.label: a
children.prompt: radius $5\text{ cm}$ and containing an angle of $45^{\circ}$

answer.short: A sector of radius $5\text{ cm}$ with central angle $45^{\circ}$.
answer.worked: Draw a radius $5\text{ cm}$ long. At its centre endpoint, use a protractor to mark $45^{\circ}$ and draw the second radius. Set the compasses to $5\text{ cm}$ and draw the minor arc between the two radii, keeping the compass point at the centre.

spec.description: Authored completed construction: two equal radii enclosing 45 degrees and their minor circular arc; no question diagram is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; printed answer is a representative drawing, not an actual-size construction.

children.label: b
children.prompt: diameter $14\text{ cm}$ and containing an angle of $150^{\circ}$

answer.short: A sector of radius $7\text{ cm}$ with central angle $150^{\circ}$.
answer.worked:
$$r=\frac{14}{2}=7\text{ cm}.$$
Draw a radius $7\text{ cm}$ long. At its centre endpoint, use a protractor to mark $150^{\circ}$ and draw the second radius. Set the compasses to $7\text{ cm}$ and draw the $150^{\circ}$ arc between the radii, keeping the compass point at the centre.

spec.description: Authored completed construction: two equal radii enclosing 150 degrees and the corresponding circular arc; no question diagram is supplied.
spec.mathematics: Underlying circle diameter 14 cm; radius 7 cm; central angle 150 degrees.
